title: A result that changed
text: Tell us about a result that did not support your initial idea.

options.text: Our results always supported our ideas.
options.response: 这个回答回避了问题，也没有展示处理不确定性的能力。

options.text: We had a problem, and I asked my supervisor for help.
options.response: 求助很正常，仍需要说明你如何理解和处理了问题。

options.text: The first result disappeared after we fixed the data split. We reported the correction and redesigned the experiment.
options.response: 你把变化、行动与认识连起来了，研究经历因此可信。
